items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: That's where Edda Pearson was playing and Matt Leeson and a bunch. They was in that band. Yeah, my brother's band.

ctx.x: Is that a local band? That was a local band.

And then they had the Rapsodians. That's where the Sales brothers used to play with. Man, you say, his brother's... I can't see Man, he never got a band. The Sunnie South. His brother, then they had the Sunnie South band around here. That's where Edda Pearson was playing and Matt Leeson and a bunch. They was in that band. Yeah, my brother's band. And Bigfoot Bill, he had a... The piano band. No, the drummer. The drummer. Bigfoot Drummer, he had a band too. He had a big band around here. And they had the Crescent…
